runtime.architecture: Procedural Three.js geometry; fixed six-room floorplan, 36 blueprint-selected props

runtime.behavior: Offline LLM-authored repeating tasks, deterministic runtime; no live LLM calls
runtime.limitations: Task work uses idle clips; announcements are narrative; no atmosphere/power/damage simulation or crew-to-crew collision avoidance
